thread:
Sophie: Heads-up — AtlasCloud asked for a small, opinionated IaC bundle so partners can onboard Redwood models to their marketplace offering quickly. They want a single terraform module + a tiny example app, minimal IAM, and an option to use partner-managed images.

Tasha: ok — do they need multi-region or just a single-region quickstart?

Sophie: single-region for MVP, but with clear knobs for multi-region (routing) later. Also need KMS integration optional and an env var pattern for private registries.

Alan: +1. Proposal: publish a module "redwood/partner-lite" that provisions: VPC peering (or VPC endpoint), a nodepool (1-3 nodes), a tiny service for a sample model, and an optional ALB + healthchecks. Keep variables minimal: region, instance_type, image, enable_kms (bool), kms_key_arn, enable_autoscale (bool).

Devon: can we make it cloud-agnostic / provider-specific via folder variants? e.g. aws/, gcp/, azure/ with the same variable surface. That keeps partner-facing docs consistent.

Maya: +1 to variants. Also suggest an examples/ directory with a demo app that hits the Redwood hosted API or can switch to private deployment via env var. Add a tiny test harness in GitHub Actions to `terraform init/plan` and `apply` to a sandbox account.

Alan: sample usage snippet for AWS module (draft):

```
module "redwood_partner" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/partner-lite//aws"
  region = "us-west-2"
  instance_type = "c6i.large"
  image = "123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-partner:stable"
  enable_kms = true
  kms_key_arn = "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abc-123"
  enable_autoscale = false
}
```

Tasha: can we add a toggle for prefix KV-cache volumes? Partners will want to reuse disk cache across restarts for faster cold-starts.

Alan: good call — add `kv_cache_persistent = bool` and `kv_cache_size_gb`. Keep defaults off.

Devon: tests — CI should perform: `terraform fmt`, `terraform validate`, `terraform plan` against a mocked backend, then a smoke deploy step that spins up the sample and curls /health. Use small instance types to keep partner costs low.

Sophie: timeline? AtlasCloud wants a partner-facing artifact in 2 weeks for their marketplace submission.

Maya: I can own docs + example app. Devon — can you own CI harness? Alan — module implementation? Tasha — partner requirements & acceptance criteria?

Devon: I can do CI. Plan: create repo skeleton today, CI PoC in 3 days, smoke job by EOW.

Alan: I'll start module scaffolding tonight. Will push a first PR with aws/ and a generic README.

Tasha: I'll compile a one-pager with acceptance criteria (security checklist, minimal IAM, KMS optional, private registry support, tests pass). Will ping legal for marketplace T&Cs.

infra-bot: New repo created: github.com/redwood-inference/partner-lite (private). Default branch: main.

Sophie: awesome. Action items: Devon (CI), Alan (modules), Maya (docs+example), Tasha (partner sign-off). Target: demo to AtlasCloud on 1716640000 (two weeks).

Devon: noted. I'll open the GH issue board and link CI tasks.

Alan: will post PR link when ready.

Maya: drafting README + quickstart with screenshots.

Tasha: will schedule partner sync once PR is ready for review.

Sophie: thanks team :tada: — small and opinionated is the goal. Keep the terraform surface tiny and add advanced examples in /examples for partners who want more control.

Devon: also adding a small lint/cost-estimate step into CI so partners can see a nominal monthly estimate (rough).

Maya: +1, helps partner sales.

Sophie: cool. closing loop here — will follow up after the first PR.

(End of thread)
